implementation.providerIdSource: Existing bootstrap-provider/adapter-manifest verification; no provider ID translation. The saved WI-050 registry externalProviderId and Provider local providerId both equal isr.vehicle.ugv.ugv1.
providerInstanceIdSourcePriority: Existing process-local telemetryInstanceId: configured OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID or the existing UUID generated once at startup
implementation.providerInstanceIdCapture: TaskEngine requires an explicit valid local instance. New admission captures it in admission_intent and provider_task. Configured empty/invalid values are not replaced. No historical backfill/default/server-derived identity.
implementation.recovery: An observed durable admission must still exist; recoverAdmission cannot create a replacement intent. Existing admission owner and original correlation context are reused. Mismatched stored task/admission owners conflict.
implementation.response: One _meta[io.sdar/providerIdentity] sibling with exactly profileVersion=1.0, providerId and providerInstanceId, generated from Task storage for create/get/notification projections.
implementation.protocolPreserved: Existing status, TTL, timestamps, result projection and strict io.sdar/taskExecution metadata/revision semantics are unchanged.
implementation.providerOps: Committed Task lifecycle/command/operational records and Task-linked ProviderTelemetryIngress records use the stored Task owner. Audit export no longer overwrites instanceId with the exporting process. Correlation/trace claims are emitted under attributes.correlation, not top-level aliases.
implementation.originClaims: Explicit canonical Provider origin claims are retained as non-authoritative reconciliation material; they never supply or override local task/provider/instance/execution identity.
implementation.otelDistinction: The OTEL resource may describe the current emitting process; a Task-linked ProviderOps body instanceId describes the admitted Task owner.

migration.scope: Provider Runtime migration set only; admission_intent/provider_task provider_instance_id NOT NULL with nonempty bounded value.
migration.precondition: Clean development bootstrap. Existing populated task/admission databases are not upgraded by guessing an owner; legacy-data compatibility is intentionally unsupported.
